Are you asking for the function that does this? If so, please clarify: do you mean adaptive regression splines? 
And you would like to use non squared loss? Say adaptive regression splines for glms?
If so, have a look at `splines::ns()`, which can be used in formulas of many models, such as `lm()` and `glm()`.

I would try to explain myself better:

my data is: y_.

my model.list is:
n=nrow(y_)
B1=matrix(list("b"),1,1)
U1=matrix(0,1,1)
Q1=matrix(c("q11"),1,1)
Z1=matrix(rep(1,n))
A1=matrix(rep(0,n))
R1=diag(n)
diag(R1)=c(rep("r",n))
pi1=matrix(0,1,1)
V1=diag(1,1)
model.list=list(B=B1,U=U1,Q=Q1,Z=Z1,A=A1,R=R1,x0=pi1,V0=V1,tinitx=0)

mt model is:
MLEobj=MARSS(y_, model=model.lisr, method="BFGS", fir=TRUE, control=list(maxit=2000, lower=c((1/J),0.0000001*matrix(1,1,8-2), -Inf, -Inf)), silent=2)
MLEobj$par=MLEobj$start
kfList=MARSSkfss(MLEobj)
xsmooth=fkList$xtt[,1:ncol(kfList$xtt)

After I run this model I discovered that I need to fit my data a non linear and non-Gaussian MARSS model (because the errors are not Gaussian).
Therefore I want to replace my model in a non linear and non Gaussian one.

Hope that I was more clearly now..

thanks,
Amit

messages.author: a305e65fa9dfb74d
messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] non-linear and non-Gaussian MARSS models
parts:
I now see that MARSS has nothing to do with MARS. How confusing :-)

Having no experience whatsoever with these models, I still wonder:

(1) From what I can tell, your model parameters seem stationary. If this is the case, you might consider the `vars` package instead, which does vector autoregression with stationary covariance.

(2) Why is Gaussianity important? If it is for the purpose of testing, you can probably bootstrap the problem. If it is not for testing, and if you have long time series, I suspect your estimates are still consistent even if Gaussianity breaks. It is also possible that the CLT kicks in so that inference is good enough even if the errors are non Gaussian.

Having said that, I really have no experience with these models, so please correct me if I am wrong.
